design_philosophy: Industrial-professional, modern, clean, organized, easy for production operators. Focus on clear production workflow, readable tables, and high printability.

layout.sidebar: Fixed width (approx 250px), dark theme for high contrast against light app area, scrollable for ~15 modules. Collapsible on tablet.
layout.topbar: Sticky, white background, breadcrumb navigation, user profile, print buttons.
layout.cards: Flat, 1px border-slate-200, shadow-sm, rounded-md (industrial precision, no large rounded corners).

tables.style: Dense, striped rows for readability, sticky header.
tables.actions: Right-aligned action buttons (Edit, Print, Delete) with text or clear icons.

badges.style: Rounded-full, px-2.5 py-0.5, text-xs font-semibold, 1px solid border.

buttons.primary: bg-amber-600 text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 hover:bg-amber-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500 focus:ring-offset-2 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-300 rounded-md px-4 py-2 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors
buttons.print: bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 hover:bg-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2

rules: Hide sidebar, topbar, and all navigation elements.
Remove background colors from cards, borders to solid black (border-black).
Expand tables to 100% width, use pt/cm for typography sizing if necessary.
Ensure QR codes on Bundle Labels render at exact readable size (e.g., 3cm x 3cm) with high contrast.
Force page breaks for specific modules (e.g., page-break-after: always for Batch Color Sheet vs Bundle Label).

icons.style: Regular or Bold weight, dense and professional.

images.description: Spacious factory interior featuring large overhead cranes and metal walkways.
Automotive electronics relay / red coated wires

testing.required_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI components but override border radiuses to be sharper (e.g., rounded-md instead of rounded-lg or xl) for an industrial look.
Implement pure CSS @media print for the Cutting Sheet, Bundle Label, and QC Checklist.
Use a robust table component to handle dense data like 'Product Recipe' and 'Pin Map'.
Ensure 'Batch Color Sheet' incorporates clear warning UI (yellow/red text or icons) for substituted cable colors.
Generate QR Codes using a library like 'qrcode.react' for the Bundle Labels.
Ensure all Bahasa Indonesia text is clear and formal (e.g., 'Simpan', 'Cetak', 'Ubah', 'Hapus', 'Perintah Kerja').
